rationale: Test whether repeated prior resistance contacts add information to a daily volume breakout; prior generic breakouts failed. This is a weak-prior incremental test, not a new economic family or assumed edge.
searchAccounting: One new fixed variant plus its prespecified component controls; related and failed versions remain part of the search burden. No threshold optimization or exit rescue.
cap: NO CAP FILTER. Whole liquid ordinary-stock population with dated identity. Neither small-cap replication nor a dollar-volume surrogate for market cap.

signal.level: Maximum split-consistent adjusted high over prior60 completed regular sessions, excluding signal bar
signal.touchChoice: Greedy oldest-to-newest prior-session highs within1% below frozen level; spacing at least5 sessions; no future pivot/retest
signal.breakout: completed regular close strictly above prior level and no more than5% above; prior close at/below that same level; close above current50-session SMA
signal.volume: signal volume at least1.5 times prior20-session average on a consistent split basis

entry: Next regular session open only after completed signal close. Expires at that open. Missing/open halt has NO_FILL_OR_UNKNOWN, never shifted to later price. One independent open position per stock per variant.

exit.fixed: Regular close of10th session counting entry as1; no stop, target, intraday retest or discretionary exit. Missing/delisted settlement remains UNKNOWN, no last-mark sale.

costs.shares: floor((1000-3)/(raw entry open*(1+adverse))); no fractional shares or uninvested-cash leverage
costs.limitations: Daily OHLC modeled fills are not executable proof; displayed size is not fill capacity; historical ZAD UNKNOWN. Additional orders would each cost3 but this fixed model has one buy and one sell.

comparisons: Identical daily base/volume breakout with only touch-count requirement removed, same fixed10-session exit
Average eligible stock at same entry/exit sessions with identical whole-share costs
Same stock on other eligible non-signal dates with same fixed exit
SPY and IWM on same entry/exit windows with identical costs
Same-industry same-date eligible controls where genuine dated classification exists; otherwise UNKNOWN
Untouched exact DEC2-ZANGER original frozen study, contextual only; no exit substitution or head-to-head equivalence claim
evaluation: Chronological older signals before2024 and newer signals from2024; both already explored market periods, NOT untouched confirmation. Report n, mean, median, losses, worst, without best2 and best5%, concentration, overlapping capital demand. Unknown outcomes preserved separately; no promotion, portfolio return/drawdown or t-test from incomplete/dependent trades.
coverageFirst: Default run is COVERAGE ONLY. No signal enumeration or outcome calculation in requested run. Any subsequent analysis requires reviewed PASS coverage and a separate bounded approval; this contract prevents post-coverage threshold selection.
